inputs: Immutable archived 306B/343 public line proposal lists, original verified support masks; no unread material
method: Preserve the original top three. If their band centres fit within 3mm, replace only slot four with the highest score-length-neighbor-vote candidate at least 3mm from their weighted centroid. Pool top10, neighbor Gaussian sigma 1.25mm. Otherwise preserve fourth.
comparison: Exact mask-supported published-target centreline and box coverage at fixed four-proposal budget; retain all original outcomes and show area selected
advance_condition: On both 306B claim variants second published row centerline coverage increases, first row does not decrease, PHerc343 18-box >=50% count not reduced, and no proposals are fabricated on blank/shuffle. If any criterion fails, retain original ranking and document failure.
next_gate: Independent uninspected public positive/blank source or prospectively fixed private lane required before replacing production review order; existing full-map inspection remains mandatory.
resource_cap: GitHub Actions CPU-only Ubuntu, 15 minutes; ~180MB of pre-hashed public source downloads; no CUDA or model forwards
limitations: Retrospective method design after original source outcomes were known, not an unbiased held-out experiment; 306B variants share the same text, 343 is a display image
